alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women seated upright on padded wooden benches at different heights beside a forested blue-green lake and waterfalls. A braided woman wears an emerald mini with silver star-like seams, the blonde wears an ivory sleeveless shell and green skort, and two others wear red, white and blue Croatian-flag minis. Their hands link across the seating levels. Rainbow stockings, rainbow boots, emerald RAZE sandals, and crescent and scorpion arm tattoos appear. The scene is serene, with covered midriffs and no disaster imagery.
